limits: Lower bound proven only for n >= k-1; small-horizon case left to Exercise 15.3.
Proof uses Gaussian noise for easy KL; only needs D(P_i,P_i') = O((mu_i - mu_i')^2) for small gaps (Notes 1).
No contradiction with O(log n) upper bounds: those depend on inverse gaps, which may be large (Notes 2).
The 1/27 constant is not claimed tight; Exercise 15.2 route gives 1/8 with a different form.
practices: To lower-bound minimax regret, pick a base bandit, then choose a second environment depending on the policy (least-pulled suboptimal arm) so that the policy suffers large regret in one of them (Fig 15.1, p.200).
Use the divergence decomposition D(P_nu,P_nu') = sum_i E_nu[T_i(n)] D(P_i,P_i') to turn a regret bound into an expected-pull bound (Lemma 15.1, p.198).
Use the Bretagnolle-Huber inequality (Theorem 14.2) to lower-bound the sum of error probabilities by (1/2)exp(-D) (p.200-201).
